# Mismatched sequence

## Statement

The service MUST expose a filename whose sequence disagrees with its identifier.

## Rationale

This fixture exercises the filename-to-identifier sequence check.

## Acceptance criteria

- The filename sequence does not match the identifier sequence.

## More information

None.
